algorithm_name: TACT — Trust-Anchored Confidence Tempering (working name RTC; renamed to avoid the ReASC / "reliability-aware" collision, since our "reliability" is a property of the confidence CHANNEL, not of a response)
summary:
TACT turns the confidence channel of a frozen LLM into a *budgeted* voting resource. It (1) maps each trace's confidence to a within-item, monotone-invariant score phi (default: van der Waerden normal scores of the within-item midranks), (2) votes with w_i = exp(gamma * phi_i), (3) sets gamma by measuring the SIGNED within-item discrimination of the channel — pooled Somers' D (= 2*WQD - 1, the stratified Mann-Whitney statistic) — and pushing it through a positive-part James-Stein / soft-threshold shrinkage followed by the equal-variance normal-discriminant link gamma = sqrt(2)*Phi^{-1}((1+D_tilde)/2), clipped to +/- gamma_max.

The design is minimax-first, and the whole architecture follows from one asymmetry: for a weighted vote, UNDER-trusting the channel costs O(gamma_err^2) and is bounded by SC; OVER-trusting or MIS-SIGNING it degenerates toward argmax-confidence and is unbounded below (R5: 0.412; RASC-lite: 0.062). Three consequences: the shrinkage is a hard dead zone (gamma is EXACTLY 0, hence output is bitwise-identical to SC, whenever the measured discrimination is not significant at level nu); the map is odd in D so a negative channel is exploited rather than merely survived; and the label-free variant spends all its statistical effort on the SIGN, because every bias in the agreement proxy's MAGNITUDE attenuates toward zero, i.e. toward SC, i.e. toward safety.

Two variants. TACT-dev: one labeled dev split, one scalar, closed form, no grid search. TACT-LF: agreement-with-plurality pseudo-labels on unlabeled traffic, with near-duplicate collapsing, margin gating, split-half (Hui-Walter) de-attenuation using the CONSERVATIVE (upper) bound on the attenuation factor, cross-fitting across items, three echo diagnostics that clamp gamma to 0, and a stricter nu with half the cap.

Honest positioning, up front: "discrimination not calibration" is CISC's own WQD point and 50-year-old Murphy/DeGroot-Fienberg forecasting theory; rank-based confidence voting with an exponent is self-certainty Borda; the shrinkage is Efron-Morris/fractional-Kelly; the label-free machinery is Raykar/Hui-Walter/Parisi. TACT's claimed novelty is exactly three things: (a) the exponent is a measured, SIGNED, shrunk statistic with exact SC and CISC anchor points rather than a swept hyperparameter; (b) the adversarial kappa_c < 0 axis and a never-below-SC design with stated exact conditions; (c) a label-free signed-reliability estimator for a single exchangeable confidence channel — plus a proof that its sign is information-theoretically unidentifiable under confident echo, so the guarantee is published as conditional.
emphasis:
ROBUST / MINIMAX FIRST. Every design choice is justified by worst-case regret over the kappa_c range, not by average-case gain.

(1) OBJECTIVE. Let A(gamma; theta) be expected accuracy at matched budget under regime theta, gamma*(theta) = argmax_gamma A(gamma; theta) the oracle. The headline metric is MAXREG(method) = max_{theta in Theta} [ A(gamma*(theta); theta) - A(method; theta) ] over Theta = the 7-point kappa_c sweep crossed with regimes (i)-(vi). TACT is designed to minimize MAXREG among methods with no test-time ground truth, NOT to maximize mean accuracy. This is the primary reported number and the primary claim.

(2) WHY THE LOSS IS ASYMMETRIC (the whole argument). Write S_A(gamma) = sum_{i in A} exp(gamma*phi_i). At gamma = 0, S_A = n_A (SC counts). As |gamma| -> inf, argmax_A S_A -> the cluster containing argmax_i (sign(gamma)*phi_i): the vote collapses to a SINGLE trace. So A(gamma) interpolates SC (m-sample majority, variance ~ 1/m) and 1-sample selection-by-confidence (variance ~ 1, and accuracy = P(the extreme-confidence trace is correct), which under kappa_c < 0 is BELOW the per-trace base rate). Near gamma*, A is locally quadratic: A(gamma) ~ A(gamma*) - (1/2)L(gamma - gamma*)^2. Far above, A falls off a cliff to the 1-sample-under-adversarial-selection floor. This is exactly the Kelly overbetting asymmetry, and it dictates: shrink hard, cap hard, and never let a noisy estimate buy a large exponent.

(3) MONOTONE INVARIANCE AS ADVERSARY-PROOFING. The default phi is rank-based (van der Waerden normal scores of within-item midranks). This makes the entire pipeline — the weights AND the reliability statistic D — invariant to any strictly increasing within-item reparameterization of c. An adversary (or a deployment shift, or an RLHF overconfidence squash) that applies ANY monotone distortion to the confidence channel cannot move a single decision. ECE moves; AUC/Somers' D does not. Corollary: regime (ii) (overconfident-but-discriminative) is handled by construction, not by tuning. Cost: raw-magnitude information in the tails is discarded; regime (iv) tests that cost and we report it as a loss, not hide it.

(4) SIGN BEFORE STRENGTH. The map g is ODD: g(-D) = -g(D). A mis-signed gamma is the only way TACT can lose badly, so sign errors are what the estimator is engineered against: a dead zone that returns exactly 0 rather than a small wrong-signed number; nu_dev = 1.2816 (dev) and nu_LF = 2.326 (label-free, 2% two-sided); the LF significance test run on the RAW agreement statistic (whose sign is unbiased under rho_bar < 1/2) rather than on the de-attenuated one (whose magnitude is model-dependent); and an optional "dev sign bit" mode where 50 labeled items fix the sign and unlabeled traffic supplies the magnitude.

(5) BIAS DIRECTION IS A SAFETY PROPERTY. The agreement proxy attenuates |D| by (1 - 2*rho_bar). Attenuation moves gamma toward 0, i.e. toward SC, i.e. toward the G2 floor. So the DEFAULT LF configuration under-corrects on purpose: de-attenuation divides by the UPPER confidence bound of (2p-1), never the point estimate. We would rather lose 0.01 to CISC on R1 than lose 0.30 to SC on R5.

(6) WHERE IT CANNOT HOLD — stated, not buried. Never-below-SC fails, provably, in three places: (a) confident echo above plurality, where the LF sign is unidentifiable (Parisi et al. global sign ambiguity in new clothes; Hui-Walter two-root ambiguity); (b) heterogeneous per-item kappa with adversarial alignment between the negative-kappa subpopulation and the decision-flippable items; (c) tail-only informative confidence, where the monotone exponential family is misspecified and TACT returns SC (safe, but leaves the oracle gap open). Regimes (i), (iii), (iv) exist precisely to measure these, and the paper reports them as documented limitations.
math:
NOTATION
Items q = 1..Q. Item q has m_q traces. Trace (q,i) yields an answer a_{q,i}, mapped by the TracePool's semantic-equivalence clustering to a cluster label k(q,i) in the set K_q of distinct clusters, and a confidence c_{q,i} in (0,1). Ground truth cluster k*_q, correctness y_{q,i} = 1[k(q,i) = k*_q] (unknown at test time). Near-duplicate similarity sim(i,j) is cached in the TracePool.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WEIGHT TRANSFORM (the voting family)
-------------------------------------------------------------------
TACT is the two-parameter family (phi, gamma):

    w_{q,i} = exp( gamma * phi_{q,i} ),    S_q(A) = sum_{i : k(q,i) = A} w_{q,i},    khat_q = argmax_{A in K_q} S_q(A).

phi is any WITHIN-ITEM CENTERED feature map, sum_i phi_{q,i} = 0. Three members:

 (a) phi^rank (DEFAULT). Midranks R_{q,i} = rank of c_{q,i} among {c_{q,1..m_q}}, ties averaged. Van der Waerden normal scores
        v_{q,i} = Phi^{-1}( R_{q,i} / (m_q + 1) ),      vbar_q = (1/m_q) sum_i v_{q,i},
        sigma_q  = sqrt( (1/m_q) sum_i (v_{q,i} - vbar_q)^2 ),
        phi^rank_{q,i} = (v_{q,i} - vbar_q) / sigma_q     if sigma_q > eps_sd (default 1e-8),   else 0.
     Properties: mean 0, variance 1 within item; invariant to every strictly increasing map applied to c within the item; DEGENERATE-SAFE — if all confidences in an item tie (the tie-heavy verbalized-confidence pathology), sigma_q = 0, phi = 0, and that item votes by plain SC regardless of gamma. Note sigma_q must be computed from the REALIZED scores, not from a closed form: for m_q = 4 the no-tie value is 0.621, for m_q = 40 it is ~0.95, so omitting it silently rescales gamma by ~1.5x across the budget frontier.
 (b) phi^val_{q,i} = c_{q,i} - mean_q(c).
 (c) phi^logval_{q,i} = log c_{q,i} - mean_q(log c).

Overflow guard: clip(gamma*phi, -50, +50) before exp. Tie-break rule TB: when the top-2 cluster scores are within 1e-12, break by (i) largest raw SC count, then (ii) the harness's canonical deterministic rule (lowest cluster id). CRITICAL: when gamma = 0 exactly, call the SC routine itself, so the output is bitwise-identical to the SC baseline (this is what makes the G2 dead-zone guarantee exact rather than statistical — see anchor_proofs).

-------------------------------------------------------------------
2. RELIABILITY STATISTIC: pooled signed within-item discrimination
-------------------------------------------------------------------
For item q with n1_q = #{i : lab_{q,i} = 1} and n0_q = m_q - n1_q (lab = y on dev, = agreement pseudo-label g in the label-free variant), the item is INFORMATIVE iff n1_q * n0_q > 0. Define via the Mann-Whitney U on midranks (this is exactly CISC's WQD, re-expressed):

    U_q   = sum_{i : lab=1} R_{q,i}  -  n1_q (n1_q + 1)/2
    AUC_q = U_q / (n1_q n0_q)                                   in [0,1], midranks give tied pairs 0.5 credit
    D_q   = 2 AUC_q - 1                                          Somers' D in [-1,1];  D_q = 2*WQD_q - 1

Pair-count weights N_q = n1_q n0_q, N = sum_q N_q over informative items (count Q_inf of them). Pooled (van Elteren stratified rank statistic):

    Dhat = ( sum_q N_q D_q ) / N.

2.1 EXACT NULL SAMPLING DISTRIBUTION. Under H0 (lab independent of c within every item; within-item exchangeability), U_q has mean n1 n0/2 and, with tie correction,
    Var0(U_q) = n1_q n0_q (m_q + 1) / 12 * [ 1 - sum_t (t^3 - t) / (m_q^3 - m_q) ],   t = tie-group sizes of c in item q,
so Var0(D_q) = 4 Var0(U_q)/(n1_q n0_q)^2 and, items being independent,
    SE0^2 = Var0(Dhat) = (1/N^2) * sum_q (4 N_q^2) Var0(AUC_q) = (1/(3 N^2)) * sum_q N_q (m_q+1) * [tie correction].
Dhat/SE0 -> N(0,1) under H0 (Lyapunov CLT over independent items; the classical van Elteren normal approximation). This is the EXACT null used for the significance gate.

2.2 NON-NULL / HETEROGENEITY-ROBUST SE. Because Dhat is a weight-mean of per-item D_q, the delete-one-item jackknife is closed form:
    S = sum_q N_q D_q ;   D^{(-q)} = (S - N_q D_q)/(N - N_q) ;   Dbar_J = (1/Q_inf) sum_q D^{(-q)}
    SE_J^2 = ((Q_inf - 1)/Q_inf) * sum_q ( D^{(-q)} - Dbar_J )^2 .
This captures BETWEEN-item heterogeneity of kappa (regime i), which SE0 does not. Cost O(Q_inf).

2.3 THE SE ACTUALLY USED (conservative): SE = max(SE0, SE_J, 1/(2*sqrt(N))). The last term is a floor preventing a degenerate SE from manufacturing a huge z. Signed SNR / score-test z:  r = Dhat / SE.

2.4 BIAS/VARIANCE BEHAVIOUR. E[Dhat] = D_true + O(1/Q) (jackknife-corrigible, not corrected by default); SE = Theta(1/sqrt(N)). With Q = 400, m = 40 and a 50% base rate, N ~ 400*400 = 1.6e5 but the EFFECTIVE independent unit is the item, so SE_J ~ 1/sqrt(3*Q) ~ 0.029. Rule of thumb: with Q_dev items, a true |D| below ~ nu * 0.6/sqrt(Q_dev) is not detectable and TACT correctly returns SC. Q_dev = 200 -> detection floor |D| ~ 0.055, i.e. AUC 0.527.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
3. TEMPERING MAP g : (Dhat, SE) -> gamma
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Two composed pieces: shrinkage rho, then the discriminant link L, then a clip.

 (S) POSITIVE-PART JAMES-STEIN WITH A SIGNIFICANCE FLOOR
        rho(r) = max( 0 , 1 - nu^2 / r^2 ),        D_tilde = rho(r) * Dhat = sign(Dhat) * max(0, |Dhat| - nu^2 SE^2/|Dhat|).
     Identity worth stating in the paper: under Dhat ~ N(D, SE^2) with prior D ~ N(0, tau^2), the posterior mean is Dhat * tau^2/(tau^2 + SE^2); the empirical-Bayes plug-in tau_hat^2 = max(0, Dhat^2 - SE^2) gives EXACTLY rho with nu = 1. Setting nu = z_{1-delta} instead makes the dead zone coincide with a one-sided level-delta score test. Defaults: nu_dev = 1.2816 (delta = 0.10 one-sided, 20% two-sided), nu_LF = 2.326 (2% two-sided).
     Properties (all elementary):
       - Dead zone: D_tilde = 0  <=>  |r| <= nu. On the null P(D_tilde != 0) = 2(1 - Phi(nu)) = 0.20 (dev) / 0.02 (LF).
       - Contraction: |D_tilde| <= |Dhat| always. TACT never trusts MORE than the point estimate.
       - Odd: rho(-r) = rho(r) so D_tilde(-Dhat) = -D_tilde(Dhat).
       - Monotone: for |r| > nu, d D_tilde/d Dhat = 1 + nu^2 SE^2/Dhat^2 > 1; inside the dead zone the derivative is 0. Hence D_tilde is nondecreasing in Dhat everywhere, continuous (both one-sided limits at |Dhat| = nu SE are 0), with a kink at the dead-zone boundary. C^0 and locally Lipschitz; C^infinity off the two boundary points.
       - Noise monotone: for fixed Dhat, |D_tilde| is nonincreasing in SE and -> 0 as SE -> |Dhat|/nu.

 (L) EQUAL-VARIANCE NORMAL DISCRIMINANT LINK
        L(x) = sqrt(2) * Phi^{-1}( (1 + x)/2 ),      gamma_raw = L( clip(D_tilde, -1+1e-6, 1-1e-6) ).
     Derivation (this is why phi must be NORMAL scores, not uniform ranks): model phi | lab=1 ~ N(mu1, 1), phi | lab=0 ~ N(mu0, 1) within item — self-consistent because phi^rank IS a normal score, standardized to unit variance. Then AUC = Phi((mu1-mu0)/sqrt(2)), so mu1 - mu0 = sqrt(2) Phi^{-1}(AUC) = L(D). Under this model the log-odds of correctness is logit p(lab=1|phi) = alpha_q + (mu1-mu0) phi, and the Nitzan-Paroush optimal vote weight for an independent voter is exp(log-odds) up to a per-item constant, i.e. w propto exp((mu1-mu0) phi). Therefore gamma* = L(D) is the BAYES-OPTIMAL exponent under the working model, not a heuristic schedule. Values: L(0.1)=0.178, L(0.3)=0.545, L(0.5)=0.954, L(0.7)=1.466, L(0.9)=2.326, L(0.99)=3.643.
     If you instead use uniform ranks or raw values for phi, L is the WRONG link (the discriminant model is misspecified) and you must fall back to a dev grid — which is the CISC baseline, not TACT.

 (C) CAP.   gamma_hat = clip( gamma_raw , -gamma_max , +gamma_max ),  gamma_max_dev = 4, gamma_max_LF = 2.
     gamma_max = 4 corresponds to |D| = 0.995 (AUC 0.9975) and matches the top of CISC's published gamma sweep, so the cap never binds in any realistic regime; it exists purely to bound the argmax-degeneration tail.

COMPOSITE:   gamma_hat = g(Dhat, SE) = clip( L( rho(Dhat/SE) * Dhat ), +/- gamma_max ).
g is continuous, odd, nondecreasing in Dhat, nonincreasing in SE (in magnitude), g(0, ·) = 0, |g| <= gamma_max, and g(D, 0+) = L(D) (the oracle exponent). See anchor_proofs for the SC/CISC reductions.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
4. VARIANT (a): TACT-dev
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Input: labeled dev items Q_dev (default 200, minimum 50), same TracePool generator as test, same budget m.
  1. For each dev item: compute midranks of c, lab = y, D_q, N_q. Skip non-informative items (all traces correct, or all wrong).
  2. Dhat, SE0, SE_J -> SE, r.
  3. gamma_hat = g(Dhat, SE). Freeze; ship the single scalar.
  4. Report the diagnostic triple (Dhat, SE, r) and the dev ECE alongside — ECE is reported, NEVER gates.
Optional refinement (report, do not default): re-estimate gamma by a 1-D concave maximization of the dev VOTING accuracy over gamma in [-gamma_max, gamma_max], then shrink toward L(D_tilde). This is deliberately NOT the default because it is the published CISC dev-tuned-T protocol and would forfeit the "no grid search" claim; it is run as baseline CISC-devT.
Cross-fitting inside dev: when reporting dev-set accuracy, use 5-fold cross-fitting (estimate gamma on 4 folds, vote on the 5th) so the reported dev number is not optimistically biased.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
5. VARIANT (b): TACT-LF — label-free / online
-------------------------------------------------------------------
5.1 DEDUP FIRST (echo mitigation, uses cached TracePool similarity). Within item q, single-linkage cluster traces at sim >= s_dup (default 0.95) into duplicate groups of sizes n_1..n_G. Assign each trace the dedup weight d_{q,i} = 1/n_{group(i)} for the purposes of PLURALITY DETERMINATION and PAIR WEIGHTING only (voting still uses all traces unless the dedup-vote ablation is being run). Kish effective size m_eff_q = (sum_g n_g)^2 / sum_g n_g^2.

5.2 PSEUDO-LABEL. M_q = argmax_A sum_{i in A} d_{q,i} (dedup-weighted plurality). g_{q,i} = 1[k(q,i) = M_q]. Vote shares v_q (plurality), v'_q (runner-up), margin mgn_q = v_q - v'_q, all dedup-weighted.

5.3 MARGIN GATE. Estimate on the subset Q_gate = { q : mgn_q >= quantile_{tau_M}(mgn) and |K_q| >= 2 }, default tau_M = 0.40 (keep the top 60% by margin). Rationale: P(plurality correct | margin) is increasing, so gating raises 1 - 2*rho_bar; the cost is variance and a mild easy-item selection bias in |D|, which is attenuating, hence safe.

5.4 RAW AGREEMENT DISCRIMINATION. Run Section 2 with lab = g on Q_gate -> Dg, SEg, rg = Dg/SEg.

5.5 POISONING ANALYSIS (this is the quantitative core of the LF claim).
 Decompose by whether the plurality is correct. Let pi_q = 1[M_q = k*_q]. If pi_q = 1 then g = y exactly and D_q^g = D_q. If pi_q = 0, the "positive" class of the pseudo-label is a WRONG cluster and the "negative" class is a mixture containing the correct traces; if confidence is positively discriminative for correctness, correct traces rank above the wrong-plurality traces and D_q^g < 0.
 Treat g as y corrupted by a class-conditional flip. Let rho_bar be the PAIR-WEIGHTED probability that the item's plurality is wrong, rho_bar = (sum_q N_q (1 - pi_q))/N. Under the class-conditional-noise (CCN) assumption — flip event independent of phi given y — every rank/AUC association attenuates linearly and preserves sign:
        E[Dg]  =  (1 - 2 rho_bar) * D_true  +  Delta_dep,           |Dg| <= |D_true|.
 THEOREM (proxy sign consistency). If rho_bar < 1/2 and Delta_dep = 0, then sign(E[Dg]) = sign(D_true) and the attenuation is exactly (1 - 2 rho_bar). Consequently the LF estimate can only UNDER-trust, never mis-sign.
 THEOREM (failure). CCN is violated exactly when the flip is CAUSED by confidence — confident echo. Adversarial worst case: an adversary places a fraction f of each item's traces on a single wrong cluster with confidences occupying the top f fraction of the within-item ranking. If f > max cluster share of the correct answer, then M_q = the echo, g = 1 on precisely the top-ranked traces, D_q^g -> +1, rho(r) -> 1, gamma_hat -> gamma_max_LF, and the vote AMPLIFIES the echo: accuracy -> 0. There is no label-free repair: the observable joint law of (answers, confidences) under {majority right, D_true < 0} and under {majority wrong via confident echo, D_true > 0} is identical — this is Parisi et al.'s global sign ambiguity and Hui-Walter's two-root ambiguity restated for a single exchangeable channel. G2 for TACT-LF is therefore CONDITIONAL on rho_bar < 1/2 after dedup, and the paper states it as such.

5.6 DE-ATTENUATION (optional, default ON, deliberately conservative). Estimate (1 - 2 rho_bar) label-free by SPLIT-HALF agreement. For r = 1..R (default 20) random balanced splits of each item's traces into halves H1, H2 (dedup-weighted), let A_r,q = 1[plurality(H1) = plurality(H2)]; alpha = mean over r,q in Q_gate. Let Keff = 1 + inverse-Simpson of the non-plurality cluster mass, pooled; k = Keff - 1. Under the one-coin model "each half returns the truth w.p. p, else a uniform draw from k wrong clusters":
        alpha = p^2 + (1-p)^2 / k   =>   (k+1) p^2 - 2p + (1 - k*alpha) = 0
        p = [ 1 +/- sqrt( 1 - (k+1)(1 - k*alpha) ) ] / (k+1).
 The +/- IS the identifiability ambiguity; take the LARGER root under the majority-competence assumption, and record the discriminant Disc = 1 - (k+1)(1 - k*alpha). Then
        att_hat = 2 p_hat - 1,      att_used = clip( UCB_{95%}(att_hat) , att_floor = 0.20 , 1.0 ),
        D_LF = Dg / att_used,       SE_LF = SEg / att_used.
 Dividing by the UPPER bound (not the point estimate) minimizes the inflation -> conservative by construction. UCB via a nonparametric bootstrap over items (B = 200) on alpha, propagated through the quadratic.

5.7 ECHO DIAGNOSTICS (any alarm => gamma_hat := 0, i.e. fall back to SC).
   E1 Duplicate collapse:  median_q( m_eff_q / m_q ) < xi_min (default 0.50).
   E2 Margin-decoupling test: let f_low = fraction of BOTTOM-margin-tercile items where the plurality cluster also has the highest mean phi; f_high = the same on the TOP tercile. Benign channels have psi = f_low - f_high <= 0 (agreement and confidence decouple on hard items). Alarm if psi > psi_max (default +0.05). This is the Jaffe-style rank-one-violation diagnostic adapted to a single channel.
   E3 Root ambiguity: Disc < 0.02 (the two split-half roots nearly coincide => alpha carries no information about p).
   E4 Absolute floor: Q_gate < 50 informative items.

5.8 SIGNIFICANCE GATE AND OUTPUT. Test on the RAW statistic (unbiased sign under 5.5), temper on the de-attenuated one:
        if any alarm or |rg| <= nu_LF:  gamma_hat = 0
        else:                           gamma_hat = clip( L( rho(D_LF/SE_LF) * D_LF ), +/- gamma_max_LF ).

5.9 ONLINE SCHEDULE WITH CROSS-FITTING. Maintain a sliding window of the last W = 200 completed items. Items 1..W_warm (default 200) vote with gamma = 0 (pure SC warmup). Thereafter recompute gamma every B = 50 items from the window ONLY (items strictly before the current one) — cross-fitting across items removes the dependence between the estimator and the decision it drives. Optional EWMA on Dhat and SE^2 with half-life 500 items instead of a hard window (use for nonstationary traffic; report both).

5.10 SEMI-LABEL-FREE MODE (recommended deployment, reported separately). If >= 50 labeled items exist, take the SIGN from dev (s = sign(Dhat_dev) if |r_dev| > 1.0, else 0) and the MAGNITUDE from unlabeled traffic: gamma_hat = s * |g(D_LF, SE_LF)| if s != 0 else 0. This purchases immunity to 5.5's failure theorem with 50 labels, and is the honest answer to "your LF guarantee is conditional".

-------------------------------------------------------------------
6. HETEROGENEITY AND MISSPECIFICATION (scope statement)
-------------------------------------------------------------------
TACT estimates ONE global channel exponent. Under per-item kappa_q, Dhat consistently estimates the pair-weighted mean E_N[D_q], and the jackknife SE_J correctly inflates. A per-item gamma_q is data-starved at m = 40 (SE of D_q alone is ~0.15); the only defensible extension is a two-level shrinkage gamma_q = L( D_tilde_global + shrink_q*(D_q - Dhat) ) with shrink_q = tau_b^2/(tau_b^2 + SE_q^2) and tau_b^2 = max(0, Var_q(D_q) - mean_q SE_q^2). This is specified as an ABLATION (TACT-hier), not the default, and regime (i) reports the gap to the per-item oracle envelope.
Regime (iv) (informative only in the tails) violates monotonicity of the optimal log-weight in phi. Extension TACT-spline: phi -> (phi, phi_tail) with phi_tail = sign(phi)*max(0, |phi| - 1), two exponents, each shrunk by its own score test with a Holm correction across the two. Ablation only; if it does not beat TACT on regime (iv) we drop it.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
7. COMPLEXITY
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Voting: O(m_q log m_q) per item (one sort), O(sum_q m_q) accumulation. Dev estimator: O(sum_q m_q log m_q) + O(Q) for the closed-form jackknife. LF adds: dedup O(m_q^2) per item from the cached similarity matrix (m=40 => 1600 ops, negligible; O(m_q) if the TracePool already stores duplicate group ids), split-half O(R * sum_q m_q) with R = 20, bootstrap O(B*Q) with B = 200. Memory O(sum_q m_q). At Q = 2000, m = 40: well under one second in numpy. gamma is a scalar; no model, no training, no extra generation.

# ============================================================================
# TACT — Trust-Anchored Confidence Tempering.  numpy + scipy only.
# Drop-in against the existing TracePool harness.
# ============================================================================
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, rankdata

SQRT2 = np.sqrt(2.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- config ---
class Cfg:
    phi_kind    = "rank"     # "rank" (default) | "val" | "logval"
    eps_sd      = 1e-8
    nu_dev      = 1.2816     # one-sided delta=0.10 dead zone
    nu_lf       = 2.3263     # one-sided delta=0.01 dead zone
    gamma_max_dev = 4.0
    gamma_max_lf  = 2.0
    # label-free
    s_dup       = 0.95       # near-duplicate similarity for echo collapse
    tau_M       = 0.40       # keep top 60% of items by vote margin
    R_split     = 20         # split-half replicates
    B_boot      = 200        # bootstrap reps for the attenuation UCB
    att_floor   = 0.20
    xi_min      = 0.50       # E1 duplicate-collapse alarm
    psi_max     = 0.05       # E2 margin-decoupling alarm
    disc_min    = 0.02       # E3 root-ambiguity alarm
    q_gate_min  = 50         # E4
    W_window    = 200        # online window (items)
    W_warm      = 200        # SC-only warmup
    B_refresh   = 50         # recompute gamma every B items

# =================================================== 1. WEIGHT TRANSFORM ===
def phi_map(c, kind=Cfg.phi_kind):
    """Within-item centered feature map. Returns array of len(c), mean 0."""
    c = np.asarray(c, float)
    if kind == "rank":
        R = rankdata(c, method="average")                 # midranks, ties safe
        v = norm.ppf(R / (len(c) + 1.0))                  # van der Waerden
        v = v - v.mean()
        s = np.sqrt((v * v).mean())
        return v / s if s > Cfg.eps_sd else np.zeros_like(v)   # all-tied -> SC
    if kind == "val":
        return c - c.mean()
    if kind == "logval":
        lc = np.log(np.clip(c, 1e-6, 1.0))
        return lc - lc.mean()
    raise ValueError(kind)

def sc_vote(clusters, tie_break):
    """The harness's own SC routine.  Called verbatim when gamma == 0."""
    ks, cnt = np.unique(clusters, return_counts=True)
    return tie_break(ks, cnt.astype(float), cnt)

def tact_vote(clusters, c, gamma, kind=Cfg.phi_kind, tie_break=None):
    if gamma == 0.0:
        return sc_vote(clusters, tie_break)     # bitwise-identical to SC
    w = np.exp(np.clip(gamma * phi_map(c, kind), -50.0, 50.0))
    ks = np.unique(clusters)
    sc = np.array([w[clusters == k].sum() for k in ks])
    cnt = np.array([(clusters == k).sum() for k in ks])
    return tie_break(ks, sc, cnt)

# ============================================ 2. RELIABILITY STATISTIC ====
def somers_d_item(c, lab):
    """Signed within-item discrimination.  D = 2*AUC-1 = 2*WQD-1.
       Returns (D_q, N_q, m_q, tie_corr) or None if not informative."""
    lab = np.asarray(lab).astype(bool)
    n1, n0 = int(lab.sum()), int((~lab).sum())
    if n1 == 0 or n0 == 0:
        return None
    m = n1 + n0
    R = rankdata(c, method="average")
    U = R[lab].sum() - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2.0
    D = 2.0 * (U / (n1 * n0)) - 1.0
    _, tc = np.unique(c, return_counts=True)
    tie = 1.0 - ((tc**3 - tc).sum() / (m**3 - m)) if m > 1 else 0.0
    return D, float(n1 * n0), m, tie

def pooled_D(items):
    """items: iterable of (c_array, lab_array). Returns Dhat, SE, r, Qinf."""
    D, N, M, TC = [], [], [], []
    for c, lab in items:
        out = somers_d_item(c, lab)
        if out is not None:
            D.append(out[0]); N.append(out[1]); M.append(out[2]); TC.append(out[3])
    if len(D) < 2:
        return 0.0, np.inf, 0.0, len(D)
    D, N, M, TC = map(np.asarray, (D, N, M, TC))
    Ntot = N.sum(); S = (N * D).sum(); Dhat = S / Ntot
    # exact null SE (van Elteren, tie-corrected)
    SE0 = np.sqrt((N * (M + 1.0) * TC).sum() / 3.0) / Ntot
    # delete-one-item jackknife, closed form  -> heterogeneity robust
    Q = len(D)
    Dloo = (S - N * D) / (Ntot - N)
    SEJ = np.sqrt((Q - 1.0) / Q * ((Dloo - Dloo.mean())**2).sum())
    SE = max(SE0, SEJ, 1.0 / (2.0 * np.sqrt(Ntot)))
    return float(Dhat), float(SE), float(Dhat / SE), Q

# ================================================ 3. TEMPERING MAP g ======
def temper(Dhat, SE, nu, gamma_max):
    """g(Dhat,SE): positive-part JS shrinkage -> discriminant link -> cap."""
    if not np.isfinite(SE) or SE <= 0.0:
        return 0.0
    r = Dhat / SE
    if abs(r) <= nu:
        return 0.0                                   # DEAD ZONE -> exact SC
    rho = 1.0 - (nu * nu) / (r * r)                  # in (0,1)
    Dt = np.clip(rho * Dhat, -1.0 + 1e-6, 1.0 - 1e-6)
    gamma = SQRT2 * norm.ppf((1.0 + Dt) / 2.0)
    return float(np.clip(gamma, -gamma_max, gamma_max))

# ================================================ 4. VARIANT (a) DEV ======
def fit_tact_dev(dev_pool):
    """dev_pool: list of dicts {c, clusters, y}.  Returns gamma + diagnostics."""
    Dhat, SE, r, Q = pooled_D([(it["c"], it["y"]) for it in dev_pool])
    gamma = temper(Dhat, SE, Cfg.nu_dev, Cfg.gamma_max_dev)
    return gamma, dict(D=Dhat, SE=SE, z=r, n_informative=Q, mode="dev")

# ============================================= 5. VARIANT (b) LABEL-FREE ==
def dedup_weights(sim, s_dup=Cfg.s_dup):
    """Single-linkage collapse of near-duplicate traces -> weight 1/groupsize."""
    m = sim.shape[0]; parent = list(range(m))
    def find(a):
        while parent[a] != a: parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]; a = parent[a]
        return a
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(i + 1, m):
            if sim[i, j] >= s_dup:
                ri, rj = find(i), find(j)
                if ri != rj: parent[ri] = rj
    root = np.array([find(i) for i in range(m)])
    _, inv, cnt = np.unique(root, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    d = 1.0 / cnt[inv]
    m_eff = cnt.sum()**2 / (cnt**2).sum()
    return d, float(m_eff)

def lf_item_stats(it):
    d, m_eff = dedup_weights(it["sim"])
    ks = np.unique(it["clusters"])
    mass = np.array([d[it["clusters"] == k].sum() for k in ks]); mass /= mass.sum()
    o = np.argsort(-mass)
    M = ks[o[0]]; v = mass[o[0]]; v2 = mass[o[1]] if len(o) > 1 else 0.0
    g = (it["clusters"] == M).astype(int)
    return dict(M=M, g=g, margin=v - v2, m_eff_ratio=m_eff / len(d),
                n_clusters=len(ks), d=d)

def split_half_alpha(items, R=Cfg.R_split, rng=None):
    rng = rng or np.random.default_rng(0)
    agree, kacc = [], []
    for it in items:
        cl = it["clusters"]; m = len(cl)
        for _ in range(R):
            p = rng.permutation(m); h1, h2 = p[:m//2], p[m//2:]
            f = lambda ix: max(np.unique(cl[ix]),
                               key=lambda k: (cl[ix] == k).sum())
            agree.append(float(f(h1) == f(h2)))
        st = it["_lf"]; mass = np.array(
            [ (cl == k).sum() for k in np.unique(cl) if k != st["M"] ], float)
        if mass.sum() > 0:
            p_ = mass / mass.sum(); kacc.append(1.0 / (p_**2).sum())
        else:
            kacc.append(1.0)
    return float(np.mean(agree)), float(np.mean(kacc))

def solve_p(alpha, Keff):
    """Hui-Walter two-root solve.  Returns (p_large_root, discriminant)."""
    k = max(Keff, 1.000001)                 # k = number of wrong clusters
    disc = 1.0 - (k + 1.0) * (1.0 - k * alpha)
    if disc <= 0: return np.nan, disc
    return (1.0 + np.sqrt(disc)) / (k + 1.0), disc

def fit_tact_lf(window, dev_sign=0, rng=None):
    """window: list of dicts {c, clusters, sim}.  No labels used."""
    rng = rng or np.random.default_rng(0)
    for it in window: it["_lf"] = lf_item_stats(it)
    mgn = np.array([it["_lf"]["margin"] for it in window])
    thr = np.quantile(mgn, Cfg.tau_M)
    gate = [it for it in window
            if it["_lf"]["margin"] >= thr and it["_lf"]["n_clusters"] >= 2]
    diag = dict(mode="lf", n_gate=len(gate))
    if len(gate) < Cfg.q_gate_min:
        return 0.0, {**diag, "alarm": "E4_too_few_items"}

    Dg, SEg, rg, _ = pooled_D([(it["c"], it["_lf"]["g"]) for it in gate])
    diag.update(D_raw=Dg, SE_raw=SEg, z_raw=rg)

    # ---- echo diagnostics -------------------------------------------------
    xi = float(np.median([it["_lf"]["m_eff_ratio"] for it in window]))
    lo, hi = np.quantile(mgn, [1/3, 2/3])
    def top_phi_is_plurality(it):
        ph = phi_map(it["c"]); ks = np.unique(it["clusters"])
        best = max(ks, key=lambda k: ph[it["clusters"] == k].mean())
        return float(best == it["_lf"]["M"])
    f_low  = np.mean([top_phi_is_plurality(i) for i in window if i["_lf"]["margin"] <= lo])
    f_high = np.mean([top_phi_is_plurality(i) for i in window if i["_lf"]["margin"] >= hi])
    psi = float(f_low - f_high)
    alpha, Keff = split_half_alpha(gate, rng=rng)
    p_hat, disc = solve_p(alpha, Keff)
    diag.update(xi=xi, psi=psi, alpha=alpha, Keff=Keff, p_hat=p_hat, disc=disc)
    for name, bad in (("E1_dup_collapse", xi < Cfg.xi_min),
                      ("E2_margin_decoupling", psi > Cfg.psi_max),
                      ("E3_root_ambiguity", not np.isfinite(disc) or disc < Cfg.disc_min)):
        if bad:
            return 0.0, {**diag, "alarm": name}

    # ---- conservative de-attenuation (UCB on 2p-1) ------------------------
    boot = []
    for _ in range(Cfg.B_boot):
        s = rng.choice(len(gate), len(gate), replace=True)
        a_b, k_b = split_half_alpha([gate[j] for j in s], R=4, rng=rng)
        pb, db = solve_p(a_b, k_b)
        if np.isfinite(pb): boot.append(2 * pb - 1)
    att_ucb = np.quantile(boot, 0.95) if boot else 1.0
    att = float(np.clip(att_ucb, Cfg.att_floor, 1.0))
    D_lf, SE_lf = Dg / att, SEg / att
    diag.update(att=att, D_lf=D_lf)

    # ---- gate on RAW sign, temper on de-attenuated magnitude --------------
    if abs(rg) <= Cfg.nu_lf:
        return 0.0, {**diag, "alarm": "dead_zone"}
    gamma = temper(D_lf, SE_lf, Cfg.nu_lf, Cfg.gamma_max_lf)
    if dev_sign != 0:                       # semi-label-free mode (5.10)
        gamma = dev_sign * abs(gamma)
    return gamma, diag

# ============================================ 5.9 ONLINE DRIVER ===========
def run_online(stream, tie_break, dev_sign=0):
    """One pass over unlabeled test traffic.  Cross-fit: gamma at item t is
       estimated ONLY from items < t."""
    preds, gammas, gamma, buf = [], [], 0.0, []
    for t, it in enumerate(stream):
        preds.append(tact_vote(it["clusters"], it["c"], gamma,
                               tie_break=tie_break))
        gammas.append(gamma)
        buf.append(it); buf = buf[-Cfg.W_window:]
        if t + 1 >= Cfg.W_warm and (t + 1) % Cfg.B_refresh == 0:
            gamma, _ = fit_tact_lf([dict(b) for b in buf], dev_sign=dev_sign)
    return np.array(preds), np.array(gammas)

anchor_proofs:
All proofs are for the family w_{q,i} = exp(gamma * phi_{q,i}) with phi within-item centered, S_q(A) = sum_{i in A} w_{q,i}, decision argmax_A S_q(A) with a fixed tie-break TB.

=====================================================================
A1. EXACT REDUCTION TO SC AT ZERO TRUST (gamma = 0)
=====================================================================
Set gamma = 0. Then w_{q,i} = exp(0) = 1 for every trace of every item, so
    S_q(A) = sum_{i : k(q,i)=A} 1 = n_q(A),
the plain self-consistency vote count. The argmax over A of S_q(A) is therefore the argmax of the SC counts, and by the implementation rule "if gamma == 0.0, call the SC routine itself" the tie-break is the SC tie-break byte for byte. Hence

    TACT(gamma=0) == SC   as FUNCTIONS on every trace pool, not merely in distribution.

Consequence for the paired harness: on any TracePool replay, the McNemar 2x2 table between TACT(0) and SC has b = c = 0 discordant pairs; the paired accuracy difference is identically 0 with zero variance. This is why the shrinkage uses a HARD dead zone rather than a smooth shrink to a small nonzero value: it converts "non-inferior in expectation" into "identical", which no statistical test can reject.

When does the estimator actually return exactly 0? By construction rho(r) = max(0, 1 - nu^2/r^2) = 0 iff |r| = |Dhat|/SE <= nu. Under H0 (D_true = 0), r -> N(0,1) by the van Elteren CLT, so
    P(TACT == SC exactly | D_true = 0) -> 2*Phi(nu) - 1 = 0.7995 at nu = 1.2816 (dev),  0.9798 at nu = 2.3263 (LF).
On the complementary event gamma_hat is not 0 but is CONTINUOUS through the boundary: as |r| -> nu+ we have rho -> 0+, D_tilde -> 0+, and gamma_hat = L(D_tilde) -> L(0) = sqrt(2)*Phi^{-1}(1/2) = 0. So there is no jump: the worst that a false positive can do is apply an infinitesimal exponent. See A5 for the resulting bound on the damage.

=====================================================================
A2. EXACT REDUCTION TO CISC AT FULL TRUST
=====================================================================
CISC has two published weight forms; the family reproduces BOTH exactly.

(A2a) CISC-power, w^CISC_{q,i} = c_{q,i}^gamma.
Take phi = phi^logval, i.e. phi_{q,i} = log c_{q,i} - L_q with L_q = (1/m_q) sum_j log c_{q,j}. Then
    w_{q,i} = exp(gamma*(log c_{q,i} - L_q)) = c_{q,i}^gamma * exp(-gamma L_q) = kappa_q * c_{q,i}^gamma,
with kappa_q = exp(-gamma L_q) > 0 depending on q but NOT on i. Therefore
    S^TACT_q(A) = kappa_q * S^CISC_q(A)   for every cluster A,
so (i) argmax_A S^TACT_q = argmax_A S^CISC_q for every item (a positive common factor cannot reorder), (ii) the ties coincide, so any fixed tie-break yields the same answer, and (iii) the NORMALIZED vote distributions are literally equal:
    S^TACT_q(A) / sum_B S^TACT_q(B) = c-power share = S^CISC_q(A) / sum_B S^CISC_q(B).
Hence TACT(phi^logval, gamma) == CISC-power(gamma) as functions. QED.

(A2b) CISC-softmax (the arXiv:2502.06233 within-question-normalized form), w^CISC_{q,i} = exp(c_{q,i}/T) / sum_j exp(c_{q,j}/T).
Take phi = phi^val, i.e. phi_{q,i} = c_{q,i} - cbar_q, and gamma = 1/T. Then
    w_{q,i} = exp(c_{q,i}/T) * exp(-cbar_q/T),
again a positive per-item constant times the un-normalized CISC weight; after the within-item normalization that CISC applies, the two weight vectors are IDENTICAL element-wise:
    exp(gamma*phi_i)/sum_j exp(gamma*phi_j) = exp(c_i/T)/sum_j exp(c_j/T).
Hence TACT(phi^val, 1/T) == CISC-softmax(T) as functions. QED.
Note the limits line up with CISC's own: T -> infinity <=> gamma -> 0 <=> SC (A1), which is precisely the anchor CISC's dev-tuned-T protocol already exploits — we say so explicitly rather than claim it.

(A2c) The gamma -> infinity limit is CISC's T -> 0 limit. Let i* = argmax_i phi_{q,i}, assumed unique. Then
    S_q(A) / exp(gamma phi_{q,i*}) = sum_{i in A} exp(gamma (phi_{q,i} - phi_{q,i*})) -> 1[k(q,i*) in A]
as gamma -> +inf, since every exponent is <= 0 with equality only at i*. So the decision converges to "the cluster of the single most confident trace", i.e. argmax-confidence, which is CISC at T -> 0. Symmetrically gamma -> -inf gives the cluster of the LEAST confident trace. The family thus spans the whole segment [SC, argmax-confidence] and its mirror image, with CISC's entire dev-tuned-T curve as an interior sub-path.

(A2d) HONEST CAVEAT for the default rank parameterization. With phi = phi^rank the reduction in A2a/A2b does NOT hold element-wise, because exp(gamma * normal-score) and c^gamma agree in the ORDER of the weights but not in their magnitudes, and a weighted plurality depends on magnitudes. The exact statement is:
    TACT(phi^rank, gamma) == CISC-softmax at T = 1 applied to the recalibrated confidences c'_{q,i} = gamma * phi^rank_{q,i},
i.e. TACT-rank is CISC composed with a within-item van-der-Waerden recalibration; equivalently it is the exponential-kernel analogue of self-certainty Borda voting (N - rank + 1)^p. So the paper says: the CISC anchor is EXACT in the value/log-value parameterization (and TACT ships both, selectable by one flag), and in the default rank parameterization the anchor is exact to rank-CISC. Any claim of exact CISC reduction while using ranks would be false and we do not make it.

=====================================================================
A3. WHY gamma* = L(D) IS THE RIGHT "FULL TRUST" POINT (not just a cap)
=====================================================================
Under the working model that motivates phi^rank — phi | y=1 ~ N(mu1,1), phi | y=0 ~ N(mu0,1) within item, which is self-consistent because phi^rank is a standardized normal score — the within-item posterior log-odds of correctness is
    logit P(y=1 | phi) = alpha_q + (mu1 - mu0) * phi,
and the Nitzan-Paroush optimal weight for an independent voter is its log-odds, so the optimal multiplicative weight is exp((mu1-mu0)*phi) up to a per-item constant that cancels. Since AUC = Phi((mu1-mu0)/sqrt(2)) and D = 2*AUC - 1,
    mu1 - mu0 = sqrt(2) * Phi^{-1}((1+D)/2) = L(D).
So the link is not a schedule: it is the Bayes-optimal exponent under the model, and "full trust" means "plug in the unshrunk D". As SE -> 0, rho -> 1 and gamma_hat -> L(D_true) exactly.

=====================================================================
A4. CONTINUITY, MONOTONICITY AND SYMMETRY OF g(D, SE)
=====================================================================
g(D,SE) = clip( L( rho(D/SE) * D ), +/- gamma_max ),  rho(r) = max(0, 1 - nu^2/r^2), L(x) = sqrt(2) Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2).
 (P1) Anchors. g(0, SE) = 0 for all SE (SC). g(D, 0+) = L(D) (the A3 optimum, = the CISC operating point in the rank family). |g| <= gamma_max always.
 (P2) Oddness. rho depends on r only through r^2, so D_tilde(-D) = -D_tilde(D); L is odd since Phi^{-1}((1-x)/2) = -Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2); clip is odd. Hence g(-D,SE) = -g(D,SE). No structural bias toward positive confidence — the method exploits an anti-correlated channel with the same machinery it uses for a correlated one, rather than merely surviving it.
 (P3) Continuity. D_tilde(D) = sign(D) max(0, |D| - nu^2 SE^2/|D|) is 0 at |D| = nu*SE and continuous there from both sides (both one-sided limits equal 0); it is C^infinity elsewhere. L is C^infinity on (-1,1); the clip is continuous. So g is C^0 on R x (0,inf), piecewise C^infinity, and Lipschitz on every compact set avoiding |D_tilde| = 1. In particular a vanishing estimated reliability produces a vanishing exponent — the continuous degradation demanded by G2, with no jump between "gate open" and "gate closed" (this is exactly what the binary ECE gate lacks).
 (P4) Monotonicity in evidence. For |r| > nu, d D_tilde/dD = 1 + nu^2 SE^2 / D^2 > 1; inside the dead zone the derivative is 0. So D_tilde is nondecreasing in D on all of R, strictly increasing outside the dead zone. L' (x) = sqrt(2) / (2 phi_pdf(Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2))) > 0. clip is nondecreasing. Composition: g is nondecreasing in D, strictly increasing wherever the dead zone and the cap are both inactive.
 (P5) Monotonicity in noise (shrinkage). For fixed D != 0, |D_tilde| = |D| - nu^2 SE^2/|D| is strictly decreasing in SE and hits 0 at SE = |D|/nu; for larger SE it stays 0. Hence |g(D,SE)| is nonincreasing in SE and g -> 0 as SE grows. More data -> more trust; noisier estimate -> more shrinkage; this is the James-Stein/fractional-Kelly behaviour requested, in closed form with no tuning beyond nu.
 (P6) Contraction / never over-trust. |D_tilde| <= |D| with equality only in the limit SE -> 0, so TACT's exponent never exceeds the exponent implied by the raw point estimate. Combined with (P1) this bounds the entire trajectory inside the segment [SC, oracle-under-the-working-model].

=====================================================================
A5. NEVER-BELOW-SC: WHAT IS PROVED, WHAT IS ARGUED, WHERE IT FAILS
=====================================================================
PROVED (P-1, exact). If gamma_hat = 0 then TACT == SC pointwise (A1). By A1 this event has probability 2*Phi(nu)-1 under the null.

PROVED (P-2, small-gamma inertness). Fix an item q and let U_q = max_i |phi_{q,i}|. For clusters A, B with SC counts n_A > n_B,
    S_q(A) >= n_A e^{-gamma U_q}  and  S_q(B) <= n_B e^{+gamma U_q},
so the SC decision between A and B is preserved whenever n_A e^{-gamma U} > n_B e^{gamma U}, i.e. whenever
    gamma < gamma_0(q) := log(n_A / n_B) / (2 U_q).
With counts being integers, n_A/n_B >= (n_B+1)/n_B, so any item whose SC margin is at least one vote is UNCHANGED for all gamma below an explicit positive threshold. Consequence: as gamma -> 0+, the ONLY items whose decision can change are those with an exact SC TIE at the top, and on those the limit rule is "break the tie toward the cluster with the larger sum of phi". Therefore
    lim_{gamma -> 0+} A(gamma) - A(0) = E[ over SC-tied items: P(correct cluster has larger mean phi) - (tie-break baseline) ],
which is >= 0 iff the channel is positively discriminative (D_true > 0) and <= 0 iff D_true < 0. Since g is odd and (by P-4 below) sign-consistent, TACT applies gamma with the sign that makes this term nonnegative. There is no first-order downside; all downside is O(gamma^2).

ARGUED (P-3, null-regime non-inferiority). At D_true = 0, gamma_hat is 0 with prob 2Phi(nu)-1 and otherwise satisfies |gamma_hat| <= L(|Dhat| - nu^2 SE^2/|Dhat|) with |Dhat| = O_p(SE) = O_p(Q^{-1/2}); conditional on the dead zone being escaped, |gamma_hat| = O_p(Q^{-1/2}) as well because rho -> 0 at the boundary. Combined with P-2 (accuracy change is quadratic in gamma once ties are excluded, and ties are a vanishing fraction at m >= 8), the expected accuracy deficit versus SC at D_true = 0 is O(1/Q) — one to two orders of magnitude below the pre-registered non-inferiority margin at Q = 2000. This is an asymptotic statement, NOT a theorem, and F2 is the empirical test of it. We do not claim a finite-sample dominance theorem, because none exists for weighted plurality with estimated weights.

CONDITIONAL (P-4, sign consistency). TACT-dev: E[Dhat] = D_true + O(1/Q), so P(sign error) <= P(|N(0,1)| > nu * (1 + |D_true|/SE)) -> 0 exponentially in Q for any fixed D_true != 0. TACT-LF: sign consistency holds iff the pair-weighted plurality-wrong rate rho_bar < 1/2 AND the class-conditional-noise assumption holds (flip independent of phi given y); see math 5.5.

FAILS, EXACTLY HERE (state in the paper, do not hide):
 (F-a) Confident echo above plurality. If the wrong cluster is both the plurality and the top of the confidence ranking, then {majority right, D_true<0} and {majority wrong, D_true>0} induce the SAME observable law on (answers, confidences). No label-free estimator can separate them (Parisi et al.'s global sign ambiguity; the +/- roots of the Hui-Walter quadratic in math 5.6). TACT-LF's guarantee is therefore CONDITIONAL on rho_bar < 1/2 after dedup, protected empirically by E1-E3 and eliminated only by the 50-label sign bit of math 5.10.
 (F-b) Heterogeneous per-item kappa with adversarial alignment. Dhat > 0 can coexist with a subpopulation of items having D_q < 0; a single global gamma > 0 damages that subpopulation. Net non-inferiority holds if the decision-flip sensitivity is not negatively aligned with D_q; it can be violated by construction. Regime (i) measures the gap; TACT-hier is the ablation.
 (F-c) Non-monotone optimal weighting (tail-only informative confidence). The exponential-in-phi family cannot represent a U-shaped log-weight; Dhat ~ 0, TACT returns SC — safe, but the oracle gap stays open. Regime (iv) quantifies it.
 (F-d) Distribution shift dev -> test. TACT-dev freezes gamma; if the test channel's D differs in SIGN from dev's, TACT-dev inherits CISC's failure. This is the case where TACT-LF (which re-estimates online) is the argument for the paper; regime (vi) is designed to show it.

2. METRICS
=====================================================================
PRIMARY (matches the minimax emphasis):
  MAXREG(method) = max over the 7 kappa points (at each budget) of [Acc(ORACLE-gamma) - Acc(method)], reported with a clustered-bootstrap 95% CI (1000 reps, resampled by item). The headline claim is that TACT-dev and TACT-LF have the smallest MAXREG among all no-test-time-label methods, at every budget.
SECONDARY: mean accuracy over the sweep; per-cell accuracy; SC-gap = Acc(method) - Acc(SC) with its full distribution over cells; token-matched frontier curves; ESTIMATOR QUALITY: scatter of gamma_hat vs the oracle gamma*, and of Dhat vs the realized true D, with the fraction of exact zeros and the sign-error rate; LF diagnostic ROC (does the echo alarm fire when and only when rho_bar > 1/2?).

=====================================================================
3. THE FOUR PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS, SHARPENED
=====================================================================
All tests are exact paired McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs), one-sided where stated, Holm-corrected WITHIN each falsifier family. Non-inferiority margin eps_NI = 0.010 absolute accuracy (primary); eps_NI = 0.005 reported as a secondary, underpowered check.

F1 (G1: match CISC where confidence works). FAMILY = {kappa_c = +0.6} x {4 budgets} x {regimes base, ii, v} = 12 tests.
  FALSIFIED if TACT-dev is worse than the better of M4-best and M5 (CISC-devT) by more than eps_NI with Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 in ANY cell.
  Reported either way: the paired delta with CI in every cell.

F2 (G2: never significantly below SC). FAMILY = all 7 kappa x 4 budgets x 6 regimes = 168 tests per variant.
  FALSIFIED if TACT (dev or LF) is below SC by more than eps_NI = 0.010 with Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 in ANY cell OUTSIDE the pre-declared exemption set.
  EXEMPTION SET, declared now, not after seeing results: regime (iii) with p_echo >= 0.35 for TACT-LF only (the identifiability limit of anchor_proofs F-a). Failures inside the exemption set are reported as the documented conditional limitation, and the secondary requirement there is that TACT-LF stays within 0.02 of SC (i.e. the echo diagnostics work) — if it does not, the echo guard is declared ineffective.
  Additional pre-registered null diagnostic: at kappa_c = 0 the theory predicts P(gamma_hat = 0 exactly) = 0.80 (dev) / 0.98 (LF). Report the empirical rate across 12 seeds; a rate below 0.65 (dev) indicates SE under-estimation and invalidates the F2 analysis independent of accuracy.

F3 (does online estimation beat a crude gate?). FALSIFIED if TACT-LF does not beat BOTH the binary ECE gate (M11) AND the binary discrimination gate (M12) on MEAN accuracy averaged over the 7-point sweep, with a clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, at the two central budgets (m = 8, 16).
  Note the M12 clause is a deliberate strengthening of the seed's F3: beating only the ECE gate would be beating a strawman, since Rank-Calibration and CISC's WQD already published the ECE critique.

F4 (does CONTINUOUS tempering add anything?). Trivial-competitor set = {M5 CISC-devT, M12 binary AUC gate, M13 sign-corrected ternary gate, M14 dev-picked grid gamma}.
  FALSIFIED (negative result, published as such) if ANY member of that set has MAXREG within 0.005 of TACT-dev's MAXREG across the full grid at every budget.
  This is the falsifier most likely to fire and we say so in the pre-registration. If it fires for the dev variant only, the paper's claim shrinks to: continuous tempering is unnecessary WITH labels, and TACT's value is the label-free variant (F3) and the shift regime (F7).

F5 (NEW — the rank claim). FALSIFIED if TACT-rank does not beat TACT-value (M21) under regime (ii) MONOTONE-DISTORT by more than 0.010 at kappa_c in {+0.3, +0.6}. Strong prediction: TACT-rank's accuracy under distortion equals its undistorted accuracy to within Monte-Carlo error (exact invariance, anchor_proofs A2d), while CISC-value and the ECE gate degrade. If TACT-rank is not exactly invariant, there is an implementation bug (tie handling or sigma_q).

F6 (NEW — the echo guard). On regime (iii) with p_echo in {0.15, 0.35, 0.50}: FALSIFIED if TACT-LF with the guard ON falls more than 0.020 below SC, OR if the guard fires (gamma_hat = 0) on fewer than 80% of the p_echo = 0.50 cells, OR if it fires spuriously on more than 10% of the p_echo = 0 cells. This tests the diagnostics as a DETECTOR, separately from accuracy.

F7 (NEW — the distribution-shift claim, where TACT-dev must lose and TACT-LF must win). On regime (vi), the off-diagonal cells with sign(kappa_dev) != sign(kappa_test): FALSIFIED (the paper's main surviving claim collapses) if TACT-LF does not beat both TACT-dev and CISC-devT by more than 0.020 in the sign-flip cells. This is where the label-free variant earns its existence, given that F4 may well fire on the dev variant.

=====================================================================
4. STATISTICAL PROTOCOL AND POWER (pre-registered)
=====================================================================
Test: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on b vs c discordant pairs) for equality; for non-inferiority, the one-sided exact test of H0: Acc(TACT) <= Acc(SC) - eps_NI against H1: >, implemented as a one-sided binomial test on the shifted discordant count.
Correction: Holm-Bonferroni within each falsifier family (family sizes above); alpha = 0.05 family-wise.
Power: with N items and discordant rate d, the paired test detects a true accuracy delta of roughly 2*z_{0.8+0.95}*sqrt(d/N)/2. Empirically d ~ 0.08-0.15 in this harness. At N = 2000 and d = 0.10 the 80%-power detectable delta is ~0.014 — adequate for eps_NI = 0.010 only marginally, hence E0.4's 12 seeds (N = 4800, detectable ~0.009) for the three F2-critical kappa cells. eps_NI = 0.005 would require N ~ 15000 and is reported as descriptive only, with the CI, never as a test. This power computation is part of the pre-registration; F2 cannot be quietly rescued by underpowering.
Bootstrap: all regret and mean-over-sweep quantities use a clustered nonparametric bootstrap resampling ITEMS (1000 reps), never traces, since traces within an item are dependent.
Seeds: pool generation seeds are fixed and shared; only the method is varied. Subsample index sets for each budget are drawn once per (item, seed) and reused by every method.

5. ANALYSES THAT MUST APPEAR EVEN IF NOTHING IS FALSIFIED
=====================================================================
A. The CONFIDENCE-USAGE FRONTIER figure: x = kappa_c, y = accuracy, one line per method, oracle envelope shaded, at m = 16. This is the paper's Figure 1 and it should make the R5 collapse of M4/M7/M8/M9 and the flatness of TACT immediately visible.
B. The ESTIMATOR figure: gamma_hat (mean +/- sd over seeds) vs kappa_c, overlaid with the oracle gamma*, with the dead zone shaded. Shows continuity, oddness, and the exact-zero plateau near kappa = 0.
C. MAXREG bar chart with bootstrap CIs — the minimax headline.
D. The ABLATION LADDER table (SC -> ECE gate -> AUC gate -> ternary sign gate -> dev grid gamma -> TACT-dev -> TACT-LF), reporting MAXREG and mean accuracy, so a reviewer can read off exactly which change bought which improvement. If the AUC gate captures most of the gain, we say so in the abstract.
E. The LIMITATION table: regime (i) gap to the per-item oracle; regime (iii) exemption results with diagnostic firing rates; regime (iv) gap (monotone-family misspecification); regime (v) tie-rate and the fraction of items where sigma_q = 0.
F. COST: wall-clock and token overhead of TACT vs SC (predicted: zero extra generation, < 1 ms/item estimation), to pre-empt "is this worth it".
G. REAL-MODEL CONFIRMATION (required to survive review, flagged as such): one small instruct model x one benchmark (e.g. GSM8K-style), 40 verbalized-confidence traces per item, measuring the realized Dhat and reproducing the frontier at the ONE kappa the real channel happens to sit at. The synthetic sweep is the controlled experiment; the real run is the existence proof that the channel's D is (a) unknown a priori and (b) sometimes near zero. Reviewers WILL discount kappa_c = -0.6 as a strawman unless we headline the near-zero cells and show a real channel landing there.

hyperparameters.name: phi_kind
hyperparameters.meaning: Feature map for the vote weight w=exp(gamma*phi). 'rank' = van der Waerden normal scores of within-item midranks (monotone-invariant, default); 'val' = c minus within-item mean (gives the EXACT CISC-softmax anchor); 'logval' = log c minus within-item mean (gives the EXACT CISC-power anchor).

hyperparameters.name: nu_dev
hyperparameters.meaning: Dead-zone / shrinkage constant for the dev variant. rho(r)=max(0,1-nu^2/r^2), so gamma is EXACTLY 0 (hence output identical to SC) whenever |Dhat/SE| <= nu. nu=1 is plain positive-part James-Stein; nu=z_{1-delta} makes the dead zone a one-sided level-delta score test. Controls P(gamma!=0 | null) = 2(1-Phi(nu)).

hyperparameters.name: nu_lf
hyperparameters.meaning: Same constant for the label-free variant, set much stricter because a label-free sign error is the only unbounded failure mode. Applied to the RAW agreement statistic, not the de-attenuated one.

hyperparameters.name: gamma_max_dev
hyperparameters.meaning: Absolute cap on the exponent for the dev variant. Bounds the argmax-confidence degeneration tail. gamma=4 corresponds to |D|=0.995 (AUC 0.9975) and matches the top of CISC's published gamma sweep, so it should never bind in practice.

hyperparameters.name: gamma_max_lf
hyperparameters.meaning: Cap for the label-free variant, halved because the estimator is proxy-based and its magnitude is model-dependent (Hui-Walter de-attenuation).

hyperparameters.name: eps_sd
hyperparameters.meaning: Floor on the within-item sd of the normal scores. If sigma_q <= eps_sd (all confidences tied in that item, the lumpy verbalized-confidence pathology), phi is set to the zero vector so that item votes by plain SC regardless of gamma. This is the tie-heavy safety valve.

hyperparameters.name: Q_dev
hyperparameters.meaning: Number of labeled dev items for TACT-dev. Detection floor for the true |D| is approximately nu*0.6/sqrt(Q_dev); at 200 items that is |D| ~ 0.055 (AUC 0.527). Below Q_dev=50 the dead zone dominates and TACT-dev degenerates to SC (safe, but forfeits G1).

hyperparameters.name: s_dup
hyperparameters.meaning: Near-duplicate similarity threshold (from the cached TracePool sem/dup matrix) for single-linkage collapsing of echo traces. Collapsed groups get dedup weight 1/groupsize for plurality determination and pair weighting. Primary structural echo mitigation.

hyperparameters.name: tau_M
hyperparameters.meaning: Margin-gate quantile for the label-free estimator: keep only items whose dedup-weighted vote margin (plurality share minus runner-up share) is above this quantile. Raises P(plurality correct) on the estimation set, lowering the proxy flip rate rho_bar, at the cost of variance and a mild (attenuating, hence safe) easy-item selection bias.
hyperparameters.default: 0.40 (keep the top 60% of items by margin)

hyperparameters.name: R_split
hyperparameters.meaning: Number of random balanced split-half replicates per item used to estimate the agreement rate alpha, which feeds the Hui-Walter quadratic for the plurality-correctness probability p and hence the attenuation factor 2p-1.

hyperparameters.name: B_boot
hyperparameters.meaning: Item-level bootstrap replicates used to form the 95% UPPER confidence bound on the attenuation factor (2p-1). The UPPER bound is used in the denominator so de-attenuation systematically under-corrects, biasing gamma toward SC (safe direction).

hyperparameters.name: att_floor
hyperparameters.meaning: Lower clip on the attenuation factor used as the de-attenuation denominator. Prevents the 1/(2p-1) division from exploding when the split-half estimate says the plurality is barely better than chance.

hyperparameters.name: xi_min
hyperparameters.meaning: Echo alarm E1. If the median Kish effective-sample ratio m_eff/m across items falls below this, the traces are too duplicative for the agreement proxy to be trusted and gamma is clamped to 0.

hyperparameters.name: psi_max
hyperparameters.meaning: Echo alarm E2 (Jaffe-style dependence diagnostic adapted to one channel). psi = (fraction of BOTTOM-margin-tercile items where the plurality cluster also has the top mean phi) minus (the same on the TOP tercile). Benign channels decouple on hard items so psi <= 0; a confident echo keeps the coupling high at low margin. Alarm clamps gamma to 0.

hyperparameters.name: disc_min
hyperparameters.meaning: Echo alarm E3. Minimum value of the Hui-Walter quadratic discriminant 1-(k+1)(1-k*alpha). Near zero the two roots (competent plurality vs anti-competent plurality) coincide and split-half agreement carries no information about p, so gamma is clamped to 0.

hyperparameters.name: q_gate_min
hyperparameters.meaning: Echo alarm E4: minimum number of informative items surviving the margin gate before any nonzero gamma may be emitted.

hyperparameters.name: W_window
hyperparameters.meaning: Sliding window size (items) for the online label-free estimator. Alternative: EWMA on Dhat and SE^2 with half-life 500 items for nonstationary traffic; both are reported.

hyperparameters.name: W_warm
hyperparameters.meaning: Warmup length. Items before this index vote with gamma=0 (pure SC), guaranteeing the online variant is exactly SC until it has enough unlabeled evidence.

hyperparameters.name: B_refresh
hyperparameters.meaning: Recompute gamma every B_refresh items, always from items strictly BEFORE the current one (cross-fitting across items removes the dependence between the estimator and the decisions it drives).

hyperparameters.name: dev_sign_min_items
hyperparameters.meaning: Semi-label-free mode: minimum number of labeled items needed to fix the SIGN of gamma from dev while taking the MAGNITUDE from unlabeled traffic. This purchases immunity to the confident-echo sign ambiguity, which is information-theoretically unresolvable without labels.
hyperparameters.default: 50 (sign used only if |Dhat_dev/SE_dev| > 1.0, else sign := 0 => SC)

hyperparameters.name: eps_NI
hyperparameters.meaning: Pre-registered non-inferiority margin in absolute accuracy for falsifier F2 (never significantly below SC). Chosen jointly with the sample size: N=4800 paired items gives 80% power at ~0.009.

known_failure_modes: CONFIDENT ECHO ABOVE PLURALITY (fundamental, not fixable). If a wrong answer cluster is both the plurality AND occupies the top of the within-item confidence ranking, the observable joint law of (answers, confidences) is identical under {plurality right, channel anti-correlated} and {plurality wrong, channel correlated}. This is Parisi et al.'s global sign ambiguity and the +/- roots of the Hui-Walter quadratic. TACT-LF will confidently apply a large POSITIVE gamma and amplify the echo toward 0 accuracy. Mitigations are heuristic (dedup at s_dup, margin gating, echo alarms E1-E3, gamma_max_lf=2) and are tested as a DETECTOR in F6; the only real fix is the 50-label sign bit. G2 is published as conditional on the pair-weighted plurality-wrong rate rho_bar < 1/2 after dedup, and regime (iii) with p_echo>=0.35 is in the pre-declared F2 exemption set.

F4 FIRES ON THE DEV VARIANT (likely). Weighted-vote accuracy is flat in gamma over wide ranges, and CISC's own dev-tuned temperature protocol IS a dev-calibrated SC<->CISC interpolation. On iid dev/test splits, TACT-dev may only tie CISC-devT, the binary AUC gate (M12), and the dev-picked gamma grid (M14). If so the honest paper reports continuous tempering as unnecessary WITH labels and stakes everything on TACT-LF (F3) and the dev->test sign-flip regime (F7). We pre-register this outcome rather than discovering it in rebuttal.

ESTIMATOR JITTER NEAR kappa_c = 0 CAN FAIL F2 BY ITSELF. At true D = 0 the dev dead zone still opens 20% of the time (nu=1.2816). The theory says the resulting gamma is O_p(Q^{-1/2}) and the accuracy cost is O(1/Q), but if SE is under-estimated (e.g. SE0 used alone under item heterogeneity) the z-statistic inflates and gamma becomes non-trivially nonzero. Guard: SE = max(SE0, SE_J, 1/(2 sqrt(N))), plus the pre-registered null diagnostic that the empirical exact-zero rate at kappa=0 must exceed 0.65, checked BEFORE the accuracy analysis is interpreted.

HETEROGENEOUS PER-ITEM kappa BREAKS A SINGLE GLOBAL EXPONENT. A positive pooled Dhat can coexist with a subpopulation of items whose D_q < 0; a global gamma > 0 damages them, and net non-inferiority can be violated if that subpopulation is over-represented among decision-flippable (low-margin) items. Per-item gamma is data-starved at m=40 (SE of a single D_q ~ 0.15). Scope claimed: CHANNEL-LEVEL tempering only. TACT-hier (two-level shrinkage) is an ablation; regime (i) reports the gap to the per-item oracle envelope as a limitation.

TAIL-ONLY INFORMATIVE CONFIDENCE IS OUTSIDE THE MODEL CLASS. When confidence carries signal only in its extreme tails, the optimal log-weight is non-monotone in phi, pooled D is near zero, and TACT correctly returns SC — safe, but the entire oracle gap is left on the table (and DeepConf-style hard filtering may beat it there). TACT-spline (piecewise-linear phi with a tail knot) is offered as an ablation; if it does not win on regime (iv) it is dropped and the limitation stands.

MONOTONE-INVARIANCE COSTS TAIL MAGNITUDE. phi^rank discards the raw magnitude of confidence, so a genuinely well-calibrated channel whose absolute values carry extra information (beyond ordering) is under-exploited. The value parameterization (phi='val'/'logval') recovers it and is a one-flag switch, but it forfeits the invariance that makes regime (ii) free. There is no configuration that gets both.

TIE-HEAVY / DEGENERATE CONFIDENCE COLLAPSES THE SIGNAL. Real small-instruct-model verbal confidence piles mass on a few values (>95% ceiling). At m=4-8 the within-item midranks become largely tied, sigma_q -> 0, phi -> 0, and TACT degenerates to SC. This is SAFE but yields zero gain, and it means TACT's advantage shrinks exactly at the small budgets where test-time scaling matters most. Regime (v) measures it; report the fraction of items with sigma_q = 0.

DE-ATTENUATION IS UNSTABLE WHEN THE HUI-WALTER DISCRIMINANT IS SMALL. 1/(2p-1) blows up as p -> 1/2, and the quadratic's two roots merge. Guards: att_floor = 0.20, the UPPER confidence bound in the denominator, and alarm E3. If E3 fires often in practice, ship TACT-LF with de-attenuation OFF (att=1): it under-trusts, which loses accuracy on strong channels but never breaks G2.

DEV -> TEST DISTRIBUTION SHIFT DEFEATS TACT-dev. A frozen scalar inherits CISC's failure mode if the deployed channel's discrimination changes SIGN relative to dev. This is by design the case that motivates the online variant, but it also means TACT-dev must never be sold as robust on its own. Regime (vi) / F7 is the test.

MULTIPLE-COMPARISON BURDEN MAKES G2 EASY TO OVER- OR UNDER-CLAIM. 'Never significantly below SC anywhere' over a 7 x 4 x 6 grid is 168 tests per variant. Without Holm correction, pre-registered non-inferiority margins, AND the power calculation, G2 is either unfalsifiable (no correction, small N) or trivially falsified (no correction, large N). The protocol fixes eps_NI = 0.010, Holm within family, and N = 4800 for the critical cells, all declared before running.

NAME AND SCOPE COLLISION RISK. ReASC (arXiv:2601.02970) already occupies 'reliability-aware adaptive self-consistency' and already ships a label-free GMM calibration of test-time confidence; CISC already published WQD (discrimination-not-calibration) and dev-tuned T; self-certainty Borda already published rank-based confidence voting with an exponent; FUSE already does label-free spectral reliability estimation for verifier ensembles. If any of these is not cited, differentiated in the first related-work paragraph, and run as a baseline, the contribution reads as a repackaging. The defensible deltas are exactly: signed reliability of the CHANNEL, exact SC/CISC anchors, the shrinkage-to-SC guarantee, and the adversarial kappa_c<0 frontier.

SIM-TO-REAL. The harness's linear-Gaussian confidence model makes rank and value weighting nearly equivalent by construction, and makes the normal-discriminant link exactly correct. Regime (ii) and (v) partially break that, but a reviewer will still demand a real model. Without the real-channel run (analysis G), the strongly negative kappa_c = -0.6 cells will be dismissed as a strawman, since published audits find real channels degenerate toward ZERO discrimination far more often than toward negative.
